prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Spanish woman — the personification of the city of Barcelona — one woman who IS Barcelona as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a fierce, wild ferocity; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; heart-shaped face; eyes of natural size — almond eyes whose outer corners lift slightly, outer eye corners slightly lifted; full brows set slightly low over the eyes; a nose with a soft, rounded tip and natural width; medium-full lips of natural width; crimson eyes; sharp winged eyeliner.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist build; a single thick braid over one shoulder with long bangs falling over one eye; bright satin aluminium-silver hair with soft anodized pastel blue and rose tints.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a wide black sash wound many times around her waist the way human-tower builders wear it, its edges traced in thin red light; a fitted red top in the colour of the city's human-tower team under a long white coat slung off one shoulder; a red bandana with white spots tied around her upper arm.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a long coat slung off one shoulder, a wide sash belt and a sheath-like device on her back — an asymmetric street-samurai silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: Mediterranean blue, mosaic turquoise and sun-warmed sandstone gold — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a gralla, a slender Catalan folk shawm of clear glass with a flared bell ringed in light; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Barcelona two centuries from now, a far-future megacity between the hills and the Mediterranean: the old grid of cut-corner blocks rebuilt as terraced garden towers of white ceramic and glass whose facades ripple like waves, balconies of light curling like wrought iron; the narrow stone lanes of the ancient quarter kept exactly as they stand beneath a transparent canopy; the mosaic park on the hill kept as it stands, its broken-tile mosaics glowing softly; floating plazas between the towers where crowds ring human towers of people in red shirts and black sashes rising nine tiers high; the old tree-lined promenade traced as a river of light down to the harbour; quiet flying vehicles in lanes over the long beach and the sea under a clear night sky.
This card: on a floating plaza between the white garden towers at night, a human tower of people in red shirts and black sashes rising nine tiers behind her on a broad base of hundreds of arms, the crowd hushed around it.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
